01　我怎麼工作01　How I work

四散的資訊，
收攏成一套能運作的流程Scattered information, gathered into one process that works

客戶需求、倉庫、產品、工程、營運、報價……資訊常常散在各處。
我的做法是先把它們收攏到同一個地方，變成大家都看得懂、可以追蹤的流程。Client needs, warehouses, product, engineering, operations, quotes... information is often scattered. I gather it in one place and turn it into a process that everyone can see and track.

01

了解背景Understand the story

先完整聽懂事情的來龍去脈，不急著給答案。Listen to the whole story first, before giving answers.

02

列出問題List the questions

邊聽邊記下不清楚、可能出錯的地方。Note what is unclear or might go wrong while listening.

03

釐清問題Clarify

和客戶與內部團隊逐一確認，對齊共識。Check each point with the client and internal teams until everyone agrees.

04

處理問題Solve

設計流程、建立追蹤、協調資源去執行。Design the process, set up tracking, and coordinate resources.

05

完成Deliver

上線交付，需要時再回頭優化。Launch and hand over, and come back to improve when needed.

03　案例03　Cases

六個案例，同一套做事方式Six cases, one way of working

每個案例都遵循同一個循環：聽懂脈絡、釐清問題、設計流程、協調推動、交付結果。Each case follows the same loop: understand, clarify, design, coordinate, deliver.

01專案統籌・跨倉協調Program lead · Multi-site work

6 座倉庫的檢測 SOP 與追蹤系統Inspection SOP and tracking system for 6 warehouses

情境Situation
客戶的產品檢測橫跨 6 座全球倉庫，其中美國倉月完成率只有約 30%，客戶也很難掌握各倉的進度。The client's product inspection ran in 6 global warehouses. The U.S. warehouse finished only about 30% each month, and the client could not see progress clearly.
行動Action
先和客戶釐清檢測標準與分類，再寫成倉庫能執行的 SOP；建立線上雲端表單讓各倉回填，並協調固定人員、檢測區域與回填方式。I defined the inspection rules with the client and wrote an SOP the warehouses could follow. I built an online form for each warehouse to fill in, and arranged staff, space, and data rules.
成果Result
美國倉月完成率 6 個月內從約 30% 提升到 95%，月檢測量成長 3 倍以上（約 200 → 約 700 台）。服務後來擴展到 11 座退貨倉庫，多帶來 US$17K 以上的檢測營收。In 6 months, the U.S. rate went from about 30% to 95%, and monthly volume grew more than 3 times (about 200 to about 700 units). The service later grew to 11 return warehouses and added US$17K+ in inspection revenue.
02營運專案・流程優化Operations project · Process improvement

手動流程改成平台化作業From a manual process to a platform workflow

情境Situation
客戶每個月要花 175–640 分鐘，處理一項重複性很高的人工作業。Every month, a client spent 175–640 minutes on a repeated manual task.
行動Action
拆解客戶實際的作業步驟，對照公司平台已有的功能，重新設計流程並協助導入。I broke down the real steps, matched them to what the platform could already do, and helped the client switch.
成果Result
月處理時間縮短到 30 分鐘以內，每年最多為客戶省下 122 小時。Monthly time dropped to under 30 minutes, saving up to 122 hours a year.
03導入專案・服務擴展Implementation · Service expansion

從退貨服務擴展到海外倉儲出貨Growing a client from returns to fulfillment

情境Situation
客戶原本只使用退貨服務，還沒有使用海外倉儲與出貨服務。The client used only the return service, not overseas warehousing or fulfillment.
行動Action
了解客戶新的營運需求，協調各倉庫與內部營運團隊，逐一確認各地點的執行方式。I learned the new needs, worked with the warehouses and the operations team, and checked how each location would run it.
成果Result
服務擴展到 9 座倉點，客戶帳戶 2023 年成長約 70%，2024 年至十月年增近 90%。The service grew to 9 warehouses. The account grew about 70% in 2023 and nearly 90% year over year through October 2024.
04跨部門協作・需求轉譯Cross-team work · Turning needs into requirements

從客戶痛點到平台欄位調整From a client pain point to a platform change

情境Situation
客戶在建立訂單時有人工瓶頸，需求沒有完整反映在平台流程裡。A client had a manual step when creating orders, and the platform did not fit their real need.
行動Action
從客戶與營運的角度整理痛點，轉成產品需求，和產品、工程團隊確認要新增或調整的欄位。I collected the pain points, turned them into product requirements, and agreed on field changes with Product and Engineering.
成果Result
訂單建立時間縮短 50% 以上。Order creation time went down by more than 50%.
05數據驅動成長Data-driven growth

運動品牌活動檔期與庫存優化Sportswear brand campaigns and inventory allocation

情境Situation
每月執行 3–4 檔知名運動品牌在 Shopee、MoMo 的活動，庫存分配不均，轉換率偏低。I ran 3–4 campaigns a month for a major sportswear brand on Shopee and MoMo. Inventory was uneven and conversion was low.
行動Action
與品牌團隊規劃活動、爭取平台資源，並用銷售與庫存資料重新調整庫存分配。I planned campaigns with the brand team, secured platform resources, and reallocated inventory using sales and stock data.
成果Result
2021 年 11 月 Shopee 銷售年增 734%；轉換率從約 1% 提升到 3.8%。Shopee sales grew 734% year over year in November 2021, and conversion rose from about 1% to 3.8%.
06客戶組合管理Account portfolio

16 個 B2B 企業客戶的組合成長Growing a portfolio of 16 B2B accounts

情境Situation
同時管理 16 個 B2B 企業客戶，需要持續在客戶、全球倉庫與營運團隊之間來回協調。I managed 16 B2B accounts and worked between clients, global warehouses, and the operations team every day.
行動Action
盤點各客戶的需求，主動提出可擴充的服務，並協調內部團隊完成導入。I mapped each client's needs, suggested services they could add, and coordinated the internal teams to deliver.
成果Result
客戶組合年營收成長近 50%，從 2023 年約 US$370K 到 2024 年約 US$550K。Portfolio revenue grew about 50%, from about US$370K in 2023 to about US$550K in 2024.
